summary: E2E frontend test for the bug fix on admin project creation flow. Verified that filling only the OS field (TEST-CLICK-01) and clicking 'Criar e adicionar tarefas' successfully creates the project via POST /api/projects (200), navigates to /admin/edit-project?id=..., and shows default title 'Projeto - OS TEST-CLICK-01' with the '+ Fase' button. All assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /app/frontend/app/admin/projects.tsx uses notify() helper (defined lower in file) before its declaration usage in load()/create() — works due to function hoisting but could confuse readers. Not blocking.
Minor: date fields still accept free text (YYYY-MM-DD). Consider using a validated date picker to avoid backend 422 on malformed strings.

Console warnings observed (non-blocking): 'shadow* style props deprecated', 'props.pointerEvents deprecated', and 404/405 network errors on unrelated resources during login (likely favicon or manifest).
seed_data_creation: Created project id 6a4e5f86a77ed8fd78987b8b (OS: TEST-CLICK-01) then cleaned up via DELETE (200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix validated end-to-end. The notify() helper works (window.alert on web), setTimeout(100) before router.push allows modal to close smoothly, and empty start_date/end_date now sent as null so backend accepts payload. Test flow: login -> /admin/projects -> click '+' (data-testid='admin-projects-new-btn') -> fill input[placeholder*='Digite ou selecione'] -> click 'Criar e adicionar tarefas' -> expect POST /api/projects 200 and navigation to /admin/edit-project?id=<newId>.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Alert.alert() from React Native does not render in RN Web; also backend rejected empty strings for start_date/end_date. Fix in projects.tsx converts empty strings to null before POST and uses a cross-platform notify() helper. Verified fix works — project is created and navigation happens as expected.
